name: "Bobbies"
Ability: When you take over the Bobbies, you may place them on any rival's open control arrow. They do not count toward any Goal - they increase their owner's Basic Goal by one Group. When an Attack to Control or Destroy succeeds against the Bobbies, the attacker must either discard them or give them to a rival. This is the only way to get rid of them or move them, aside from destroying their master.
Flavor Text: Also to be ostracized are those who call themselves SubGenii but behave more like Moonies, stupidly mouthing dogma and Pinking up the church.

name: 'Frop Farm
Ability: As its action, the 'Frop Farm may remove all Action tokens from any Personality.
Flavor Text: Habafropzipulops (NOT A DRUG) . . . it virtually negates the curse of Memory, that stumbling-block to Perfection.

name: . . . Or Kill Me!
Ability: You may play this card at any time when you have no Slack. . . that is, when there are no tokens on your Illuminati.    Pick a rival who does have Slack. That player must either give you one Illuminati token (which goes on your own Illuminati), or discard a Group from his Power Structure. You cannot take any actions or free moves for the rest of that turn, other than to defend yourself against attacks.
Flavor Text: "Give me slack, or kill me."        - Last words of St. Sterno Keckhaver

Ability: Meditation on 13013 can produce amazing effects.    The Power for one SubGenius group is increased to 6. Link this card to your chosen SubGenius group.    This card may be played at any time, and counts as the action for the group it affects. The increased Power takes effect immediately.    No player may have more than one 13013 in play.
Flavor Text: This number is sacred to "Bob" for reasons too COMPLEX and SECRET to print on this little bitty card.

name: Advanced Supersonic Aluminum Nazi Hell Creatures from Beneath the Hollow Earth
Ability: Whenever the Advanced Supersonic Aluminum Nazi Hell Creatures from Beneath the Hollow Earth participate in a successful Attack to Destroy a rival's group, you may draw another Plot.
Flavor Text: Some call them Deros, or Hollow Earth Scum. Most know better than to call them at all. When they come up, it's NOT PRETTY . . .

name: Anti-Slack
Ability: Play this card at any time, on a rival who has at least two Action tokens on their Illuminati. Remove one of them. Smile sweetly or laugh nastily, as you wish. No player may be hit by more than one AntiSlack card in a turn.
Flavor Text: "When in Rome, KILL ME."            - Sterno, Pope of Arkansas

name: Attitude Mutation
Ability: Play this card at any time. You may add, remove, or reverse an alignment of any group you control.     If the group is directly controlled by the Illuminati, there is no cost to make the change; otherwise, it requires an action from that group's master. The change lasts only for the rest of the current turn. You may play only one Attitude Mutation per turn.
Flavor Text: And what we believed yesterday, we scorn today, and what we mocked yesterday, we embrace today, for the spirit of "Bob" is in us, and we needed a change anyhow.

name: Bulldada
Ability: Play this card immediately after any die roll (by any player). That roll is immediately changed, retroactively, to a 12.    You must discard three other Plot cards.
Flavor Text: "I'm here with, basically, nothing to say. And that's what I want to talk to you about tonight . . ."            - "Bob"

name: Church of Middle America
Ability: Any SubGenius group that controls the Church gets +2 to its Power (and Global Power, if it already has Global Power), just out of sheer glee.
Flavor Text: They'll never get it, even when the saucers are flying overhead.

name: Church of the SubGenius
Ability: The Church of the SubGenius may accumulate its Action tokens (Slack) each turn, though it can spend only one per action. It, and any other SubGenius groups in its Power Structure, has +2 for direct control of any SubGenius group.Special Goal: Up to three Slack (Illuminati) tokens on the Church of the SubGenius may count as groups toward your Basic Goal. This Goal cannot be combined with any other Goal.
Goal: Up to three Slack (Illuminati) tokens on the Church of the SubGenius may count as groups toward your Basic Goal. This Goal cannot be combined with any other Goal.

name: Church of the SubGenius
Ability: The Church of the SubGenius may accumulate its Action tokens (Slack) each turn, though it can spend only one per action. It, and any other SubGenius groups in its Power Structure, has +2 for direct control of any SubGenius group.Special Goal: Up to three Slack (Illuminati) tokens on the Church of the SubGenius may count as groups toward your Basic Goal. This Goal cannot be combined with any other Goal.
Goal: Up to three Slack (Illuminati) tokens on the Church of the SubGenius may count as groups toward your Basic Goal. This Goal cannot be combined with any other Goal.

name: Church of the SubGenius
Ability: The Church of the SubGenius may accumulate its Action tokens (Slack) each turn, though it can spend only one per action. It, and any other SubGenius groups in its Power Structure, has +2 for direct control of any SubGenius group.Special Goal: Up to three Slack (Illuminati) tokens on the Church of the SubGenius may count as groups toward your Basic Goal. This Goal cannot be combined with any other Goal.
Goal: Up to three Slack (Illuminati) tokens on the Church of the SubGenius may count as groups toward your Basic Goal. This Goal cannot be combined with any other Goal.

name: Church of the SubGenius
Ability: The Church of the SubGenius may accumulate its Action tokens (Slack) each turn, though it can spend only one per action. It, and any other SubGenius groups in its Power Structure, has +2 for direct control of any SubGenius group.Special Goal: Up to three Slack (Illuminati) tokens on the Church of the SubGenius may count as groups toward your Basic Goal. This Goal cannot be combined with any other Goal.
Goal: Up to three Slack (Illuminati) tokens on the Church of the SubGenius may count as groups toward your Basic Goal. This Goal cannot be combined with any other Goal.

name: Citizens for Normalcy
Ability: Secret control of these foes is a real coup for any servant of Bob. They are immune to direct attacks to control by the Church of the SubGenius, The Discordian Society, or any Weird or SubGenius group. Likewise, they may never be made a puppet of any of these groups through an automatic takeover or by moving them.     The owner of the Citizens can spend their token and an Illuminati token to cancel any Plot.
Flavor Text: They're too normal to believe. Don't believe them. They're tools of the Conspiracy.

name: Comet Hail-Bob
Ability: Play this card immediately after a rival takes control of a Group from his hand or the uncontrolled area. That Group went a little overboard in their newfound adoration for "Bob", and... well, they're no longer with us. They are destroyed, but this destruction does not count toward any Goal.     This requires an action from your Illuminati or two Church Groups.     No player may use this card more than once in a game.
Flavor Text: It's that flaming YIELD sign from the heavens, telling you the last days are near.

name: Connie Dobbs
Ability: It is possible that Connie does not exist at all, though she has been the Primary Wife of Bob since 1955, and he has never denied her reality. At any rate, she is a Primal Incarnation of Womanhood, and neither she, nor any group she controls, can be destroyed as long as Connie is both Straight and SubGenius.
Flavor Text: She is the mystic consort of "Bob," the avatar of the two-car garage and the spotless bathroom . . . yet she is also Slack!

name: Corrective Phrenologists
Ability: The Society for Corrective Phrenology believes that whacking people on the head can make them smarter and nicer. So they whack anyone who annoys them. It often works.     When the Corrective Phrenologists participate in any attack or defense against a rival's Violent group, they get a new Action token as soon as the dice are rolled.
Flavor Text: Your personality is ruled by the lumps on your head. Maybe some new lumps would improve your personality, eh?

name: Dallas Catacombs
Ability: Any group in your Power Structure may be placed on any side of its master's card, and moved to any other side of that card at any time, regardless of where the master's outgoing control arrows are. A group cannot have more puppets than it has outgoing control arrows. If you lose control of the Catacombs, you must immediately move all groups to their masters' actual control arrows. This is a free move, but any group that does not now fit in your Power Structure must be discarded!
Flavor Text: Beneath the gleaming glass tower that is SubGenius World Headquarters lies a maze of tunnels . . . No one has mapped them. No one.

name: Decency is OK!
Ability: Play this card to cancel any action taken by or aided by a rival's Weird group.
Flavor Text: That's right! It's actually OK if you don't want to indulge in public debauchery, or even in mockery of ALL YOUR NEIGHBORS HOLD DEAR! There are many paths to Slack, and one of them is to ABASH those who would force their own path on you.

name: Devival
Ability: Play this card at any time to give +10 Power or Resistance (your choice) to any SubGenius group you control.     If used with an action, it must be played when that action is first declared, and counts only for that action. If used for defense, the bonus lasts until the end of the current turn and does not count toward Goals. This card may only count once in any action or defense.
Flavor Text: A prime duty of every SubGenius is to SPREAD THE WORD. No one who has participated in a Devival will ever be quite the same again.

name: Divine Mail Order
Ability: The holy Mail Order Department of the SubGenius Foundation spreads Slack and Dobbsheads to the masses. . . and brings in serious bucks.     You may spend its action to draw a Plot card. You may spend its action and an Illuminati action to draw three plot cards!
Flavor Text: The greatest offerings, of course, are those dollars spent to buy CHURCH GOODS bearing the holy DOBBSHEAD!

name: Dobbstown
Ability: All true SubGenii yearn for Dobbstown and the company of their own kind. Its owner has a +5 on any attempt to control a SubGenius Personality.
Flavor Text: Deep in the wilds of Malaysia, behind the high walls that hold back the jungle, lies a futuristic Utopia . . .

name: Dokstok
Ability: He who controls Dokstok may dispense Slack to the masses! Your Illuminati gets an extra token during the token-placement phase of your turn, which must be given to or traded to another player's Illuminati - or discard again - before you may do anything else. This is all you may do with it! Make them fight and beg for it. Demand strange and repulsive favors. Enjoy yourself.
Flavor Text: A traveling festival of peace and light and utter, deranged, manic weirdness.

name: Dr. K'Taden Legume
Ability: Dr. Legume preaches the Word of Bob to all who cannot escape his rantings.     While you control Dr. Legume and he remains a SubGenius, no one may make any kind of attack against any other SubGenius Personality you control.
Flavor Text: This is a certified religion of scorn and vengeance directed at THEM . . .

name: Drs. for "Bob"
Ability: Their Power can be used to defend any SubGenius group you control, as a free move, without using a token.
Flavor Text: Musicians, artists, philosophers, public nuisances . . . The Drs. For "Bob" and their AntiMusic have played a huge part in the development of SubGeniosity.

name: Eternal Salvation or Triple Your Money Back
Ability: Play this card at any time. Draw enough new Plots to fill your hand out to 5. You may only play this card once per game. It requires an action from one SubGenius group.
Flavor Text: Two, count 'em, TWO paradises for $30 . . . one while you're alive, lasting as long as you want, and one when you decide to die! No other religion offers a better deal!

name: Excremeditation
Ability: Place an Action token on any SubGenius groups whose Power adds up to 5 or less. This card may not benefit a group that already has any tokens, or a group which is suffering from any effect that prevents it from getting Action tokens. This card may be played at any time. It requires an action from your Illuminati.
Flavor Text: So where do you do most of YOUR reading?

name: Fake Healing
Ability: Play this card on your turn to reduce the Resistance of any groups in the uncontrolled area (or in your hand) to 0 until the end of the current turn.
Flavor Text: "The PILS of "Bob" . . . (NOT A DRUG) . . . "            - Book of the SubGenius,    "Health, the Industrial Diet, and Bad Things"    "At least one HEALING or casting out of demons is required at each Service . . . If no Member requires a Healing, then a Fake Healing must be held, and will generate equal Slack . . ."             - Book of the SubGenius,    "Starting Your Own Church"

name: False OverMan
Ability: Play this card at any time except during an attack. Link it to any Personality in play, either uncontrolled or controlled by any player. Increase his Power to 3, but he becomes Violent and Straight! If he was Peaceful or Weird, those alignments are lost.     This card cannot affect someone who is already an OverMan.
Flavor Text: But when those Yeti genes go WRONG, the price is TERROR . . .

name: False Prophets
Ability: Control of the False Prophets gives +4 on any attempt to control or destroy a rival's Church group.
Flavor Text: They're everywhere, mocking the words of the holy and interfering with mankind's salvation.

name: False Slack
Ability: Play this card at any time. Choose one Group (other than an Illuminati) controlled by a rival. Remove all its Action tokens, and those one its puppets, and their puppets, and so on. This requires an action from your Illuminati. No one may be hit with more than one False Slack in a single turn.
Flavor Text: "Leisure activities" are the Cheese, The Conspiracy provides the Maze, and YOU are the Rat! The nibbling greedy RAT!! They dangle enough fancy stereos and ski trips in front of you and maybe you'll BITE . . .

name: Give Me Slack, or Give Me Food
Ability: Play this card immediately after you use a Plot. Discard this card instead, plus one other, and put the first Plot back into your hand.
Flavor Text: Or give me my card back.

name: Glorps
Ability: Double their Power to Attack to Destroy a SubGenius group, or to aid such an attack. Triple it for any such attack if they are also controlled by a player who has become the AntiBob by exposing the AntiBob Goal.
Flavor Text: They're worse than Pink. They are knowingly Pink and revel in it. They are the natural servants of the Enemy . . . yet sometimes they may be duped into serving "Bob".

name: Goal: Arise!
Ability: You are so Illuminated that you can triumph in defeat. If a rival removes your last puppet, reveal this Goal. Instead of being out, you stay in until the end of the turn. And if you still have no puppets, you WIN! You may share a victory, even with a rival playing the same Illuminati, with this Goal.
Flavor Text: "Perhaps the best way to win any Conspiracy game is to simply WALK OUT. Steal the silverware on your way to the door.            - The Book of the SubGenius"Okay, but we're playing at YOUR house."            - Evil Stevie

name: Goal: Brag of the SubGenius
Ability: Any SubGenius group with a Power of 3 or more counts double toward your total number of groups controlled.
Flavor Text: " . . . when they plug me in, the lights go out in Hong Kong! I weigh 666 pounds in zero gravity, come and get me! My physical type cannot be classified by science . . . I'm so ugly the Speed of Light can't slow me down and Gravity won't tug at my cuffs!"

name: Goal: Cast Out False Prophets!
Ability: As a Goal: Destroy one Illuminati group of the same type as yours, by eliminating its last group.    Or as a regular Plot: +10 to destroy the False Prophets, or any of their puppets, or their master, unless they're directly controlled by the Illuminati.
Flavor Text: A heretic is someone who shares ALMOST all your beliefs. Kill him.

name: Goal: Science Cannot Remove the Terror of the Gods!
Ability: Control Church groups, and destroy Science or Church groups, in any of the following combinations:    Destroy 2 Science or Church, control 5 Church    Destroy 3 Science or Church, control 4 Church    Destroy 4 Science or Church, control 3 Church    Destroy 5 Science or Church, control 2 Church    Destroy 6 Science or Church, control 1 Church    This Goal cannot be combined with other Goals in any way.
Flavor Text: Because Science now tells us that the END TIMES are coming . . .

name: Goal: The Anti"Bob"
Ability: You have joined the Evil One, and your true Goal is to subvert the Church from within!    You win if you control at least six SubGenius groups and have destroyed at least two SubGenius or Weird groups belonging to your rivals.     If you voluntarily expose this Goal, you get one extra Illuminati token. . . but then nothing anyone does can hide it again, or remove it from your hand! You may only earn one token per game this way.
Flavor Text: Some say his name is OBO. Some say it is Ed. Some say other stupid stuff. But he is REAL and he is NOT ON OUR SIDE.

name: Good Sex for Mutants Dating League
Ability: The League matches up those hard-to-match people (et cetera). In the process, they improve the morale of the whole Weird community. All your rivals suffer an automatic -2 on any attempt to control a Weird group, because they'd rather join you.

name: Head Launching
Ability: Play this card at any time. The group of your choice now has Global Power equal to its Permanent Power. Link this card to the group.    This requires an action from the affected group. You must also discard two other plots.
Flavor Text: Now you've REALLY got their attention.

name: Inherently Bogus
Ability: Play this card at any time, except during an attack, on any Church of the SubGenius Illuminati which has no SubGenius groups in its Power Structure. They look suspiciously Pink! They lose one Illuminati token. No player may be hit by more than one Inherently Bogus card in a turn.
Flavor Text: If you are having trouble with your cash flow, it's because it isn't flowing to "Bob!"

name: Janor Device
Ability: You may add or subtract 1 - your choice - from any die roll you make. Any time you roll a natural 11 or 12, your turn ends right there (if it was your turn), and you must give the Device to a randomly chosen rival. Each rival rolls two dice, and the highest roll gets it.
Flavor Text: Aligns its holder with the Luck Plane . . . for awhile.

name: Jesus B.
Ability: Once per game, while Jesus B. is in your Power Structure, you may BUY a single point of Slack by sending one dollar to the SubGenius Foundation, PO Box 140306, Dallas TX 75214. We trust that your rivals, infuriated by your sleazy ploy, will force you to actually put the envelope in the mail!
Flavor Text: Hallelujah! As the business manager of the SubGenius Foundation, it's his duty to see that you get Slack, and a seat on that Saucer. All you have to do is send him money. LOTS of money. NOW.

name: JHVH-1
Ability: Play this card on a rival at any time. He must immediately discard half of his Plots (round up). He chooses which ones to be discarded.     This requires an action from your Illuminati.
Flavor Text: The SubGenius knows that a godlike alien space monster calling Himself Jehovah 1 is watching us and making us dance like cheap puppets for His own insidious purposes.    Depressing, isn't it?

name: Kill "Bob"!
Ability: Play this card during an Attack to Destroy against any SubGenius group. After the dice are rolled, every player who participated on the attacking side, if it succeeded, gets an Illuminati token. If the SubGenius group was yours, you get an Illuminati token regardless of the results of the dice! You may not play this card more than once per turn.
Flavor Text: Just remember, this is the religion that canonizes, bribes and enslackens its most REBELLIOUS HERETICS and CHEATS those who presume to be its most DEVOTED MONKS. Those who Kill "Bob" always return to the fold triumphant, CHANGED from pupils to Teachers.

name: League for Obvious Decency
Ability: You may spend the League's action to return up to two exposed Plots to the top of the Plot deck (or their owner's Plot deck in standard INWO).
Flavor Text: They wear their underwear on the outside, so everyone can see that they have it and that it's clean.

name: Local Clenches
Ability: Though they are wildly different in style, and seemingly powerless as individuals, control of the Local Clenches gives an extra Action token to their master each turn, if that group is SubGenius.
Flavor Text: A Clench is a local grouping of one of more SubGenii. Support your local Clench!

name: Luck Plane
Ability: Play this card immediately after any die roll (by any player). That roll is immediately changed, retroactively, to a 2.    This is an automatic success only for an attack with a net Power of at least 2; attacks with a lower Power don't even get to roll the dice.    You must discard three other Plot cards.
Flavor Text: "I'd rather be lucky than good any day."        - "Bob"

name: Martyr Meter
Ability: Place an extra Action token on one of your Personalities during the token placement phase of your turn.
Flavor Text: This miraculous yet COMPLETELY SCIENTIFIC device actually tests for False Jesii, saving the Church uncounted time and resources.

name: Mediocretinism
Ability: Play this card any time on any SubGenius group to remove that attribute until the end of the current turn.
Flavor Text: "None are so blind as those who have no eyes."        - Dr. Philo Drummond

name: Miraculous Manifestation
Ability: Play this card at any time. Each player must draw a Group and add it to the uncontrolled area.     In standard INWO, he must draw a Group, show it to you, and add it to his own hand.
Flavor Text: The face of "Bob" is seen on a tortilla in Plano, Texas. A flock of endangered whopping cranes flies into the World Trade Center, and the broken windows spell out DOBBS. A Senator resigns, saying he "needs more Slack." Truly, the world is ripe for the Word of "Bob"!

name: More Slack!
Ability: Play this card at any time in exchange for one Slack (Illuminati) token. While you are absorbed in your search for Slack, your plans become apparent to your enemies. Expose all your Plots.    No player may play this card more than once per game.
Flavor Text: The SubGenius can find Slack where NO ONE ELSE can, and use it UNFAIRLY and with MALICE AFORETHOUGHT, or JUST FOR FUN.

name: MWOWM
Ability: MWOWM is the computer that will control the Last Days. Whenever any Plot is discarded, you may spend the action of MWOWM to roll one die. If you roll a 3 or less, you get that Plot!
Flavor Text: ". . . and all them machines that'll run our lives and that BIG WHITE STONE that everybody's gonna know PERSONALLY in their own living rooms . . ."

name: Nental Ife
Ability: Play this card at any time. Link it to any SubGenius Personality. It gains Global Power equal to its Permanent Power. This costs that Personality's action.
Flavor Text: The 8th brain, the OUTER BRAIN, is a pseudophysical "shell" covering not only the other brains, but the entire body . . . The Nental Ife represents fully half of our brain power, but we can rarely make use of it.

name: NHGH
Ability: NHGH can't be destroyed. It can be controlled only by one who has exposed the AntiBob Goal.    While in the uncontrolled area, though, it adds its Power of 5 to all attempts to destroy, by any player.     In a game with no uncontrolled area, play NHGH as a Plot to add +5 to any Attack to Destroy against a rival. . . but then you must give NHGH to that rival!
Flavor Text: Speaking its name aloud is a Bad Idea. NHGH exists only for malicious jests and the absorption of Slack.

name: Official, Divine, All-Inclusive Excuse
Ability: Play this card when any attack is made against a Personality, before the dice are rolled. That attack becomes a failure.
Flavor Text: "The Lord is not slack . . ."        - I Peter 3:9    "Mockers who quote the Bible out of context will burn in hell."        - Sister Mary Margaret    "Hey, I didn't do it!"        - You, right now

name: OverMan
Ability: Play this card at any time except during an attack.     Link it to any Personality in play, either controlled by any player or uncontrolled. Increase his Power and Global Power to 3.    This card cannot affect someone who is already a False OverMan.
Flavor Text: The spawn of the Yeti is the hope of Mankind! When those Yeti genes come out, ANYTHING is possible!

name: OverMan Philo Drummond
Ability: Any Weird group Philo controls is considered to be SubGenius.    He is, of course, unaffected by the OverMan and False OverMan cards.
Flavor Text: One of the earliest servants of "Bob," Dr. Drummond is the first modern "OverMan" to be revealed in public. His Yeti genes give him superhuman powers.

name: Phlegm Elementals
Ability: When Phlegm Elementals participate in an attack, place a marker on the target group as soon as the dice are rolled, regardless of the outcome. That group is befouled. Befouled groups miss their next chance to get new Action tokens, but may then remove a befouled marker.
Flavor Text: Once human, now dissolved in their own juices, lurking in the sink traps and sewers, bubbling with hate . . . until they reach CRITICAL MASS, and emerge to FEED . . .

name: Pinks
Ability: Any time the Pinks have no Action token, they may take on from any other Straight group you control.
Flavor Text: The Pink Boys. The Sheep. Those who Do Not Get It and Don't Know There's Something To Be Gotten.

name: Psychic Pstench
Ability: Play this card at any time. One rival of your choice must expose all his Plots. Alternatively, you may play this card to force a rival to discard one exposed Goal. This Plot costs an action from a SubGenius Personality.
Flavor Text: The true SubGenius can "whiffread" your intentions from the soul-smudge you leave on your prized possessions . . . such as MONEY.

name: Rain of Prairie Squid
Ability: Play this card at any time except during an attack.    Remove all cards from the uncontrolled area. Shuffle them back into the Groups deck. Deal out an equal number of replacements.     In standard INWO, discard any number of Groups from your hand, and draw the same number.
Flavor Text: It's a sign, I tell you!

name: Random Jesii
Ability: Play this card at any time except during an attack. One chosen rival, harassed by swarms of False Jesii, must expose all but one of his Plots. This requires the action of one SubGenius or Church group.    Anyone controlling the Martyr Meter is immune to this card.
Flavor Text: ". . . horde upon horde of False Jesii . . . the New Jesus, the Old-Time Jesus, the WereJesus, the 900 Foot Tall Jesus, the Astronaut Jesus, the Lady Jesus, the Animal Jesus or the Four-Legged Jesus anyway, the Singin' Jesus, the Upside-Down Jesus . . . and the Vampire Jesus who gave His blood for you and now WANTS IT BACK . . ."

name: Rant!
Ability: Play this card during your turn, any time after your token placement phase, to take automatic control of any Group or Resource in the uncontrolled area (or from your hand in standard INWO). This requires an action from a Personality with an open control arrow. If a Group is chosen, it becomes a puppet of that Personality.    Your turn ends immediately.
Flavor Text: "I communicate without wires or strings! I am a Thuggee, I am feared in the Tongs, I have the Evil Eye, I carry the Mojo Bag; I swam the Bermuda Triangle and didn't get wet!"

name: Repent!
Ability: Play this card at the beginning of your turn, immediately after your token placement phase. Slack off, do nothing else, and end your turn. . . and take an extra token on your Illuminati.
Flavor Text: Quit your job! Slack off!

name: Reverend Ivan Stang
Ability: Chiefly responsible for Church brochures and pamphlets, Reverend Stang is now the primary spreader of the Word of Bob. Reverend Stang can give his Action token to any other SubGenius group at any time, as long as that group has no token.
Flavor Text: "Sometimes communication must be made more dangerous and irritating than necessary . . . "

name: Robo "Bob"
Ability: Play this card on your turn. Link it permanently to any SubGenius Place you control. That Place may never be controlled by another player, and has a +5 against any attempt to destroy it. This counts as the action for the place it affects. No player have more than one Robo Bob in play.
Flavor Text: The uncanny, sleepless guardian . . .

name: Rogue SubGenii
Ability: If this group has no Action token, you may discard one Plot card at any time to get one. You may do this only once per any player's turn.
Flavor Text: ". . . the feared ROGUE SUBGENIUS, capable of any unmentionable act and owing allegiance to nothing."        - SubGenius Pamphlet #1

name: S.C.A.M.
Ability: Play this card after an opponent makes any die roll. He must roll again. Playing this card is an action for a Personality.
Flavor Text: Delight them, distract them, discomBobulate them with SubGenius Confidence AnarchoMaterialization. Then clear out.

name: S.L.A.K.
Ability: Whenever S.L.A.K. has no Action token during the token placement phase of a rival's turn, it gets one.
Flavor Text: The SubGenius League of Ass-Kickers: holy storm troopers, or brutal, drug-crazed bums? Hey, why do we have to be one or the other?

name: S.P.U.T.U.M.
Ability: When they participate in an attack against a Personality, the Power of S.P.U.T.U.M. is multiplied by 3.
Flavor Text: Dedicated to the discouragement and destruction of net.spam and other Pink stuff, and the protection of the Holy Purity of the Church's virtual domains.

name: Sacred Jests
Ability: Play this card at any time. Pick one rival. He must pick one of his Plots at random and either use it immediately or discard it.     If it is a Goal, he must expose it instead. If this turns him into the AntiBob - well, so be it.
Flavor Text: Subliminal, contagious mockery of THEM . . . and not just to boggle the Pinks. The SubGenius constantly seeks to shatter and mutate the attitudes of his fellow SubGenius as well.

name: Sacred Stencil
Ability: You may add +5 to your defense when any Attack to Destroy is made against a group you control. (In standard INWO, this bonus is also good against Instant attacks.)
Flavor Text: It instantly places the Face of Dobbs, yea, the Sacred Dobbshead, on any object. Do not abuse its powers! It is also important NOT to spray-paint "SLACK" or "GIVE ME SLACK" on fences in gang-infested areas. But we digress . . .

name: Saint of Sales
Ability: Play this card on your turn. You may spend your Illuminati action, or the action(s) of SubGenius groups with a Power of at least 4, to automatically control one Resource from the uncontrolled area or from your hand.
Flavor Text: Inspired by "Bob," you make a deal that will leave them crying when they realize what they REALLY sold you.

name: Saucer Landing Strip
Ability: The visitors bring mysterious gifts. At any time you have no Plot cards, you may exchange this groups Action token for two Plots.
Flavor Text: Here, "Bob" receives the emissaries of the Xists, and others, too . . .

name: Schizm
Ability: Play this card with any attack against a group controlled by a rival. It gives +10 to that attack, but if the attack succeeds, the target group becomes uncontrolled, along with any puppets it has, and their puppets, and so on! This card does allow attacks against groups that are otherwise uncontrollable or undestroyable.     In a game with no uncontrolled area, the target group is discarded, and its puppets go to their owner's hand.
Flavor Text: "All Clenches . . . MUST SCHIZM sooner or later . . .""        -Book of the SubGenius,"        "Starting Your Own Church"

name: Secret FisTemple
Ability: The Secret FisTemple may only control Personalities, but any Personality it controls is considered SubGenius. It may give its Action token to its master or puppet, if that group is naturally SubGenius.    The Secret FisTemple automatically has all the same alignments that its master has.
Flavor Text: The followers of "Bob" are found where you least expect them.

name: Shordurpersav
Ability: Play this card immediately after any die roll you make. You may ignore that roll and try again.    This requires an action from your Illuminati or two actions from SubGenius groups.
Flavor Text: The greatest of the inventions of the SubGenius is the Short Duration Personal Savior. The true SubGenius accepts into his heart, on a strictly temporary basis, anyone or anything with which he happens to be impressed at the moment.

name: Slackfusion
Ability: Play this card at any time to let you give or receive Illuminati tokens as part of a deal, for the rest of that turn. These tokens may not go to or from other groups - just from one Illuminati to another.
Flavor Text: That wondrous SLACK TRANSFUSION that happens only through the grace of "Bob"!

name: Smite Them All!
Ability: Play this card at any time except during an attack.    Each of your rivals must choose one Group or Resource to be removed from the uncontrolled area and placed on the bottom of the Group deck. You choose two such cards, and pick last.     In standard INWO, each player chooses the Group card(s) from his own hand and places them at the bottom of his own Group deck. You must have at least two Groups in your hand to play this card.
Flavor Text: And verily, the wrath of "Bob" did descend on the unbelievers, and on the believers too, especially those who had neglected to pay their dues. And there was much wailing and gnashing of teeth. And the Righteous did laugh.

name: Speakers in Tongues
Ability: You get +3 for any attempt to control a Church group.
Flavor Text: Gulla goo yip yaaa "Bob!" Eewah bee boo ulla aiyah! Yaa gee BOO walla! Come out! Gorra goo meemah doro goo foo walla bee yup "Bob!" Magoro woola tee yip yip! Boola fee moojah OR KILL ME!

name: St. Janor Hypercleats
Ability: St. Janor exists at right angles to the Luck Plane. When he attacks, or aids an attack, a roll of 11 is not an automatic failure - but if a natural 2 is rolled, the roll is considered a 12, and his controlling Illuminati loses one token, if it had any.     St. Janor is not Secret, but he may attack any group that is Secret, or aid an attack on any Secret group, regardless of alignments.
Flavor Text: "He ain't no man . . . He ain't no god . . . I don't wanna walk the path that "Bob" trod . . . ""        -prayer of St. Janor

name: Stark Fist of Removal
Ability: Play this card on your turn. Remove all your own Illuminati tokens (minimum of 1). Pick one rival and remove all his Illuminati tokens.    Show him the Stark Fist. Optionally, read him the italicized text. Put feeling into it. Rant.    Your turn is over.
bottomRight: Requires all Illuminati Tokens, Ends Turn
Flavor Text: It is not enough merely to be a Superior Mutant, for in the end times the hand of one OverMan may be raised against another, and he who lives by the Word of "Bob" may yet DIE by the Word of "Bob."

name: SubGenius FisTemples
Ability: Any group controlled by the FisTemples gets +5 to its Resistance.
Flavor Text: "The ideal places for Church worship are hollowed-out and abandoned 1950s motels, gas stations and hamburger stands . . ."        - The Book of the SubGenius,    "Starting Your Own Church"

name: Sultan of Slack
Ability: You may play this card at any time, except during an attempt to thwart a declared victory. Until the beginning of your next turn, no player may claim victory using his Illuminati Special Goal unless he has at least as many Illuminati tokens as you do. You may not play this card more than once per game.
Flavor Text: It's not enough to have Slack. It's not enough to have more Slack. You have to have the most Slack.

name: Tape Runs Out . . .
Ability: This card may be played immediately after any other Plot is played, for any purpose. That card is canceled. Both cards are discarded.     Use of this card requires either an action from your Illuminati, or three other Plot discards.
Flavor Text: ". . . When the Rapture comes, I'll make 'em wait! They'll never clean my cage! Now give me some more of . . ."    (Tape runs out.)

name: The 13th Apostle
Ability: Place an Action token on any Personality, or on two or more Personalities whose Power adds up to 5 or less. This card may not benefit a group that already has any tokens or a group which is suffering from any effect that prevents it from getting Action tokens. This card may be played at any time. It requires an action from your Illuminati.
Flavor Text: "I don't practice what I preach because I'm not the kind of person I'm preaching to."        - "Bob," in Newsweek

name: The Hour of Slack
Ability: Whenever a group in your Power Structure is attacked by a rival, you may draw on Plot as soon as the attack is committed.
Flavor Text: Once a week, Reverend Stang's radio show brings hope to the Slackless multitudes.

name: The Prescriptures
Ability: You know what will happen before it happens. Once per turn, on your turn, you may spend the Action tokens of all your Personalities (minimum of one), or an Illuminati action, to look at either the top three cards of any two decks in the game, or one rival's Plot hand.
Flavor Text: The Holy Writings, the Word of "Bob," containing all wisdom and the True and Detailed Predictions of These Last Days.

name: The True Pipe
Ability: The Power and Global Power of your Illuminati are each increased by 2.     This cannot be combined with any other Resource that increases your Illuminati's power. The True Pipe is a jealous Pipe!
Flavor Text: "The Pipe is an alien, but it no more controls Dobbs than we control the automobiles that carry US around."        - The Book of the SubGenius,    "The True Pipe"

name: The World Ends Tomorrow and You May Die!
Ability: Play this card when you attack a group in the uncontrolled area (or in your hand, in standard INWO). The attacking group must spend its token for the attack and either have at least one alignment in common with the target or be a Media group, but the attack is an automatic success. Your turn ends immediately.
Flavor Text: Some will join you because they see the Truth. Some will join from greed. Some will join because you scared the snot out of them.

name: They May Be Pink . . .
Ability: Play this card whenever a Straight group is attacked. All your Weird and/or SubGenius groups may help in its defense.
Flavor Text: "They may be pink, but their money's green!"        - "Bob", or L. Ron Hubbard,    or perhaps both of them

name: Three-Fisted Tales of "Bob"
Ability: Link this to any SubGenius Place to increase its Power by 2, and give it Global Power equal to its new Power.
Flavor Text: This stirring text inspires SubGenii whenever it is read.

name: Time Control
Ability: Play this card during your turn to let your Illuminati attempt a direct attack, at its normal power, without spending a token.    However, you may not spend, or have spent, any Illuminati tokens this turn except to buy Plot cards.
Flavor Text: Time Control is the WEAPON that gives us our SLACK. Praise "Bob!"

name: www.subgenius.com
Ability: You may draw an extra Group card each time you start a new turn, and put it in the uncontrolled area.     Or, in a game with no uncontrolled area, you may spend this group's action at any time in order to draw a new Group.
Flavor Text: Thousands of people a day, looking for cheap laughs and filthy pictures, find enlightenment on the Web and don't even know it.

name: X-Day
Ability: Play this card at any time.    Discard all your Plots, and draw the same number of new ones, but never more than four. You may only declare X-Day once per turn.
Flavor Text: It's the end of the world, it's coming Real Soon Now, and we'll keep trying until we get it right!

name: Xists
Ability: If they are destroyed, they go to the uncontrolled area (or the hand of the player who destroyed them, in games with no uncontrolled area) and do not count as destroyed for any purpose.
Flavor Text: From their space vehicles they watch our struggle. What do they really want?

name: Yacatisma
Ability: Play this card at any time except during an attack. Pick two hidden Plots randomly from a rival's hand. He must discard them. This requires an action from a SubGenius group.
Flavor Text: Space Bikers from Hell, coming from Orion on their INTERSTELLAR CHOPPERS. Their bad vibes alone have already started tilting the Earth off its axis . . .

name: Yetis
Ability: This card may be placed on any open side of its master's card, even if there is no outgoing control arrow there! Any group may attack to control the Yetis, as long as it has an open side on which to place them.
Flavor Text: In their hidden valleys, man's hairy ancestors have little to do with their degenerate offspring. Or do they?

name: You'd Pay to Know What You Really Think!
Ability: Play this card at any time, except during an attack. Choose any group you control (other than your Illuminati), as long as it has no puppets, and put it in the uncontrolled area (in a game with no uncontrolled area, discard it). Replace it with the top card from the Groups deck. If that card is a Resource, place it with your Resources instead. If the new Group cannot be controlled by its intended master, discard it, and draw a Plot instead. The new group, if any, gets any tokens the old group had on it at the time of the switch.
Flavor Text: But that service is not available in this area at this time. Thank you for calling.
